leadText:
The Platinum arc (Japanese: プラチナ編 Platinum arc), also referred to as The Eighth Chapter (Japanese: 第八章 The Eighth Chapter), is the eighth story arc of the Pokémon Adventures , consisting of three volumes. It began serialization in March 2009, and ended in July 2010.

This arc follows as she enters the to gather information on the mysterious Distortion World so she can rescue her original bodyguards Paka and Uji. Joining Platinum is , a member of the International Police, who aims to investigate the villainous Team Galactic. Meanwhile, and set out to protect Sinnoh's Legendary Pokémon from Team Galactic's new leader, Charon.
